independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG2 scope. Its only authored files are QA tests, harnesses and evidence (tests/qa/**, e2e/a20-bilingual-shell.spec.ts, e2e/support/qa-stack.sh, e2e/clean-start/a18-clean-start.sh, docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/**). The F-DG2-310 fix (4e3c446, T-DG2-DEVOPS3) was written by devops-engineer. It changed two of those qa-verifier harnesses (with-pg.sh, qa-stack.sh) and added pg-port.sh and port-collision-check.sh. qa-verifier did not write that fix, and verified it as the finding's originator with its own independent cases on all five harnesses. The D-068 product repairs (T-DG2-BE13 strict UTF-8, T-DG2-ARCH-03 platform statuses) are by backend-workflow-engineer and solution-architect. Every result here comes from qa-verifier's own runs in a disposable clone of cf3446e4 under $TMPDIR, removed afterwards. At the start the candidate tree's HEAD was 4053630 (the round-8 freeze: 3 assignments, the manifest and stages.json, none of them manifest files), and the recomputed candidate ID matched in both trees. During this run HEAD moved to 0b99c58 (code-security-reviewer's auto-committed round-8 evidence and a round-9 assignment). qa-verifier did not open those files, and the recomputed ID at the end was still 9331e9d1…124f with 539 files. The verdict was formed without reading any other reviewer's round-8 record.

checks_run.actual: Both trees give sha256:9331e9d13e0ffa55f35ebc25ecdf9b60e159876dc2470fe56e9241a40fea124f with 539 files. HEAD 4053630 adds only 3 round-8 assignments, the candidate manifest and stages.json on top of cf3446e4. At the end HEAD was 0b99c58 (other agents' commits) and the ID was unchanged.

summary: PASS. F-DG2-310 is CLOSED_VERIFIED. One new finding: F-DG2-340 (Low, non-mandatory). Full regression of candidate 9331e9d1 (539 files, source cf3446e4) in both locale settings. Every static check exits 0; the contract has 161 operations, all declaring 429. Unit tests pass 9/9 runs at 691/691 on Node 22 and Node 24, in both locales and under load. Integration ran 5 times per locale (incl. the default port and one CPU-load run each), every run starting on attempt 1 at 547/547 with 0 skipped: 19 migrations on UTF8, DB guards, contract (161 routed, live 429 sweep), blank-text, encoding, invalid-character, framework-errors and invalid-utf8. With the QA suites included it is 587/587. F-DG2-310: all defaults are now below the ephemeral range. port-collision-check passes 5/5, and qa-verifier's own forced-TIME_WAIT cases on with-stack, qa-stack, A18 and clean-start-local retry with a log line and export the ports actually used; strict mode, non-bind failures and exhausted retries fail closed. Product e2e passes 62/62 per locale, including Define→G2 and Design→G3 in EN and AR. The QA acceptance stack passes 126/126 per locale with server_encoding UTF8 logged. Axe finds 0 violations over 592 screens. qa-verifier's R8 checks confirm D-068 on the production build: invalid UTF-8 bodies (8 shapes x 3 framings x with/without a session) are 400 validation.json; 104 undecodable-query probes across every GET query parameter are 400 validation.format; Arabic, emoji, ZWJ and combining text round-trip verbatim, even when split mid-character across chunks. F-DG2-340: the UI shows the new validation.json message twice (pre-existing RecordForm de-duplication gap). Two QA-stack attempts failed because of qa-verifier's own setup and spec race; both were explained and rerun green. The registry, CI and Keycloak residuals (D-057/D-058/D-049) are recorded on their offline or config surfaces. qa-verifier grants no business approval, and product G1-G6 never implies DG7.
